summary: Retain runtime for explicit custom-element upgrade over a shadow-including subtree.

target.notes: Try to upgrade eligible custom elements in the root's shadow-including inclusive descendants using this registry and normal upgrade reactions.

caveats: Upgrade runs author constructors and can enqueue lifecycle callbacks; it is not a type cast.

tests.name: explicit upgrade runs constructor when eligible
tests.input: const e=document.createElement('x-j2cs-e'); let n=0; customElements.define('x-j2cs-e',class extends HTMLElement{constructor(){super();n++}}); customElements.upgrade(e); console.log(n>=1);
tests.expected_behavior: prints true when the element is upgraded

tests.name: already custom element is not constructed twice
tests.input: let n=0; customElements.define('x-j2cs-f',class extends HTMLElement{constructor(){super();n++}}); const e=document.createElement('x-j2cs-f'); const before=n; customElements.upgrade(e); console.log(n===before);
